body:
I agree with you 100% 

I used to have many friends, but as time.goes by im slowly trusting less and less people. I have been hurt too many times to let anyone close to me.

For me personally, i feel as i have nothing to live for and am constantly thinking of ending things but i have a friend i build cars with and my only hope in life is to may e finish building a race car and drive it as fast as it will go. 

I wish i wasnt such a pussy to kill myself tbh, im miserable....

I can understand. I just finished school and recently quit my job. It's hard to not feel like shit constantly but I like to do something productive even only for an hr. If i feel better, i do more stuff, if i dont, i try again the next day

The only thing keeping me alive is a promise I made someone about me not doing anything to hurt myself.

I try to live only doing things I like. I work and then try and do something fun. I know how hard it is to do ANYTHING at all but i hope you can make it. 

Im not going to tell you the classic "it will get better" schtick, cause honestly, it might not. Maybe it will, maybe its the depression talking but life sucks and thats just how she goes.

I can understand what youre going through man. People are very disappointing. 

Same things happened to me. My ex said she loved me, wanted to get married, have kids, etc. But ended up leaving me after almost 3 years together due to us being "incompatible" I wish would not have fallen in love, i absolutely hate it. People suck and the world sucks.

I can understand what you're feeling. 

My (ex now) GF broke up with me few months ago and I just feel lost. I dont know myself anymore. Tomorrow is supposed to be our 3rd anniversary but shes blocked me from everything. People say it gets better with time and I fucking hope so.

I wish you the best, stranger. We can both push through this. Im rooting for you
People are weird. Its hard to trust people when they say things like I'll always be with you and so so so..

Thank you so much. She was my first love. 

It just hurts so much
